author: James Bruton
description:
Ad: this video is sponsored by Arduino and it's an ad for the new Arduino Ventuno Q. I built an auto-driving ball-wheeled omni-directional car using the Venunto Q running ROS2 and the Nav2 navigation stack. It uses two RPLIDAR S3 LIDARS to map and navigate. Be sure to visit https://www.arduino.cc/product-ventuno-q to find out everything there is to know about the new Ventuno Q!
